blocks.text: Fe'l + to va at: kimga gapiramiz, nimaga qaraymiz

listen **to**, talk **to**, look **at**, laugh **at** — bular qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars). Bu darsda: **to** va **at** bilan keladigan fe'llarning to'liqroq ro'yxati, **explain / describe / apologise** fe'llarida so'z tartibi, o'zbekchada `-ga` bo'lsa ham inglizchada predlogsiz fe'llar (phone, answer, thank, ask) va bitta fe'l ikki predlog bilan ikki ma'no beradigan holatlar: shout **at** / shout **to**, throw **at** / throw **to**. Asosiy g'oya: **to** — biror narsani kimgadir **yetkazish** (gap, javob, uzr, to'p); **at** — kimgadir yoki nimagadir **mo'ljal olish** (nigoh, kulgi, zarba).
to: talk, listen, apologise, explain, describe

**talk / speak to** somebody (**with** ham mumkin, ayniqsa amerikancha), **listen to**, **write to**, **apologise to** somebody **for** something, **explain** something **to** somebody, **describe** something **to** somebody. O'zbekchada «menga tushuntiring» — `-ga` bor, lekin inglizchada kishi fe'ldan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kelmaydi: explain **to** me yoki explain it **to** me («explain me» — xato). Savol so'zi bilan: explain **to** me **what** happened. **say** ham shunday: say something **to** somebody; **tell** esa predlogsiz: tell somebody («say me» — xato).

rows: He **explained to** me what to do.
She **told** me the truth. / She **said** it **to** me.

items.text: Could you **explain to** me why my parcel hasn't arrived yet?
items.translation: Posilkam nega hali kelmaganini men**ga tushuntirib bera olasizmi**?

items.text: Aziz **apologised to** his neighbours **for** the noise during the renovation.
items.translation: Aziz ta'mirlash paytidagi shovqin **uchun** qo'shnilari**dan uzr so'radi**.

items.text: The witness **described** the man **to** the police in great detail.
items.translation: Guvoh u odamni politsiya**ga** batafsil **tasvirlab berdi**.

blocks.text: Predlogsiz: phone, answer, ask, thank, tell

Teskari tuzoq: o'zbekchada `-ga` bor, inglizchada predlog yo'q. **phone / call / text** somebody (... ga qo'ng'iroq qilmoq / xabar yozmoq), **answer** somebody / a question / an email (... ga javob bermoq), **ask** somebody (... dan so'ramoq), **thank** somebody (... ga rahmat aytmoq), **tell** somebody (... ga aytmoq). Lekin **reply to** — predlog bilan: answer an email = reply **to** an email. «I texted to him», «answer to me», «thank to you» — xato (**thanks to** — «... tufayli» degan boshqa ibora).

items.text: I **texted** Madina to say I'd be late, but she didn't **reply to** my message.
items.translation: Kechikishimni aytib, Madina**ga xabar yozdim**, lekin u xabarim**ga javob bermadi**.

items.text: Don't forget to **thank** your aunt for the birthday present.
items.translation: Tug'ilgan kun sovg'asi uchun xolang**ga rahmat aytishni** unutma.

items.text: Why don't you **ask** the receptionist? She'll know the answer.
items.translation: Nega qabulxona xodimi**dan so'ramaysiz**? U javobini biladi.

blocks.text: at: look, stare, glance, smile, laugh, point, aim

**at** — nigoh, his-tuyg'u yoki harakat **aniq bir nuqtaga** qaratiladi: look / stare (tikilmoq) / glance (ko'z tashlamoq) **at**, **smile at** (... ga jilmaymoq), **laugh at** (... ga kulmoq, ustidan kulmoq), **point / aim at** (... ga qaratmoq, nishonga olmoq), **shoot / fire at** (... ga qarata o'q uzmoq). Nozik farq: **shoot at** somebody — o'q uzdi (tegmagan bo'lishi mumkin); **shoot** somebody — o'q tegdi. Majhulda: The advert **is aimed at** teenagers — o'smirlarga mo'ljallangan.

items.text: Why is that man **staring at** us? Do we know him?
items.translation: Anavi odam nega biz**ga tikilib qarayapti**? Uni taniymizmi?

items.text: The little girl **smiled at** me shyly from behind her mother.
items.translation: Kichkina qiz onasining orqasidan men**ga** uyalibgina **jilmaydi**.

items.text: The hunter **aimed at** the target but missed it completely.
items.translation: Ovchi nishon**ni mo'ljalga oldi**, lekin umuman tegizolmadi.

blocks.text: shout at yoki shout to? throw at yoki throw to?

Ba'zi fe'llar ikkala predlog bilan ham keladi, lekin ma'no farq qiladi. **at** — jahl, tajovuz, «nishon»: **shout at** somebody — jahl bilan baqirmoq; **throw** something **at** somebody — tegsin deb otmoq. **to** — yetkazish, hamkorlik: **shout to** somebody — eshitsin deb baland ovozda chaqirmoq; **throw** something **to** somebody — ilib olsin deb otmoq. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «... ga baqirmoq», «... ga otmoq» — farqni faqat inglizcha predlog ko'rsatadi.

rows: Don't **shout at** me — it's not my fault!
She **shouted to** us from the balcony to come up.
**Throw** the keys **to** me — I'll catch them.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «explain me» → **explain to** me; «describe me» → **describe to** me; «apologise him» → **apologise to** him; «say me» → **tell** me / **say to** me; «phone to her» → **phone** her; «answer to my question» → **answer** my question (lekin **reply to**); «thank to you» → **thank** you; «look to me» → **look at** me; «listen me» → **listen to** me; «laugh on him» → **laugh at** him; bolaga jahl bilan baqirish — «shout to» emas, **shout at**.

«**to** — qo'lga, **at** — nishonga» deb yodlang: to'pni do'stingizga **to** otasiz (u ilib oladi), raqibga **at** otasiz (unga tegsin). Baqirish (jahl bilan), kulish, tikilish, nishonga olish — hammasi «nishon» → **at**. Gap, javob, uzr, tushuntirish — «yetkazish» → **to**.

Bog'lanish: about / for / of / after bilan fe'llar — 133-dars; savolda predlog oxirida qoladi (Who are you talking **to**?) — 49-dars; ot + predlog (a reply to) — 129-dars; sifat + predlog (rude to, kind to) — 130-dars.

rows: talk / speak / listen / write / apologise to; explain / describe / say sth to sb; reply to
look / stare / glance / smile / laugh at; point / aim / shoot / fire at
shout at (jahl) / shout to (chaqirish); throw at (tegsin) / throw to (ilib olsin)
phone, call, text, answer, ask, thank, tell somebody

examples.title: **talk to**, **speak to**, **listen to**
examples.description: Gaplashish va tinglash — **to**: talk / speak to somebody (about something), listen to, write to. talk with ham mumkin.

sentences.text: I need to **talk to** my manager about my holiday dates.
sentences.translation: Ta'til sanalarim haqida menejerim **bilan gaplashishim** kerak.

sentences.text: Have you **spoken to** the landlord about the broken heating?
sentences.translation: Buzilgan isitish haqida uy egasi **bilan gaplashdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Nobody **listens to** me when I suggest something at meetings.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishlarda biror narsa taklif qilsam, hech kim men**ga quloq solmaydi**.

sentences.text: Who was Jasur **talking to** outside the office? — A client, I think.
sentences.translation: Jasur ofis tashqarisida kim **bilan gaplashayotgan** edi? — Menimcha, mijoz bilan.

sentences.text: Oliver **listens to** audiobooks on his way to work every morning.
sentences.translation: Oliver har kuni ertalab ishga ketayotib audiokitoblar **tinglaydi**.

sentences.text: You should **speak to** a lawyer before you sign anything.
sentences.translation: Biror narsaga imzo chekishdan oldin advokat **bilan gaplashib ko'ring**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wrote to** the university to ask about scholarships.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza grantlar haqida so'rash uchun universitet**ga xat yozdi**.

sentences.text: I tried to **talk to** her, but she just kept **listening to** music on her headphones.
sentences.translation: U **bilan gaplashmoqchi** bo'ldim, lekin u quloqchinida musiqa **tinglashda** davom etdi.

sentences.text: Can I **speak to** someone in the accounts department, please?
sentences.translation: Buxgalteriya bo'limidagi biror kishi **bilan gaplashsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: If you'd **listened to** your doctor, you wouldn't be in pain now.
sentences.translation: Shifokoringiz**ning gapiga kirganingizda**, hozir og'riq tortmagan bo'lardingiz.

examples.title: **apologise to** sb **for**; **explain** sth **to** sb
examples.description: Kishi — **to** bilan: apologise to somebody for something, explain something to somebody, describe something to somebody. «explain me» — xato.

sentences.text: The pilot **apologised to** the passengers **for** the two-hour delay.
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi ikki soatlik kechikish **uchun** yo'lovchilar**dan uzr so'radi**.

sentences.text: Could you **explain** this paragraph **to** me? I don't understand the second line.
sentences.translation: Bu xatboshini men**ga tushuntirib bera olasizmi**? Ikkinchi qatorni tushunmayapman.

sentences.text: Madina **described** her dream house **to** the architect.
sentences.translation: Madina orzusidagi uyni me'mor**ga tasvirlab berdi**.

sentences.text: Should I **apologise to** Kate, or wait until she calms down?
sentences.translation: Keyt**dan uzr so'rashim** kerakmi yoki u tinchlanguncha kutaymi?

sentences.text: Our guide **explained** the history of the Registan **to** us in perfect English.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz Registon tarixini biz**ga** a'lo darajadagi ingliz tilida **tushuntirib berdi**.

sentences.text: The police asked Tom to **describe** the stolen bike **to** them.
sentences.translation: Politsiya Tomdan o'g'irlangan velosipedni ular**ga tasvirlab berishni** so'radi.

sentences.text: James never **apologises to** anyone, even when he's obviously wrong.
sentences.translation: Jeyms, hatto aniq xato qilgan bo'lsa ham, hech kim**dan uzr so'ramaydi**.

sentences.text: Let me **explain** the situation **to** the others before they start panicking.
sentences.translation: Boshqalar vahimaga tushmasidan oldin vaziyatni ular**ga tushuntirib beray**.

sentences.text: When Bekzod **described** the hotel **to** his friends, he made it sound like a palace.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mehmonxonani do'stlari**ga tasvirlab berganda**, uni saroydek qilib ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: You don't need to **apologise to** me **for** being honest.
sentences.translation: Rostgo'y bo'lganingiz **uchun** men**dan uzr so'rashingiz** shart emas.

examples.title: **explain to** sb **what** / **how** / **why**; say and tell
examples.description: Savol so'zi bilan: explain to me what / how / why ... say something to somebody, lekin tell somebody — predlogsiz.

sentences.text: Can somebody **explain to** me what's going on here?
sentences.translation: Kimdir men**ga** bu yerda nima bo'layotganini **tushuntirib bera oladimi**?

sentences.text: The engineer **explained to** us how the new heating system works.
sentences.translation: Muhandis biz**ga** yangi isitish tizimi qanday ishlashini **tushuntirib berdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **said** something **to** the waiter, and he brought us another menu.
sentences.translation: Sara ofitsiant**ga** nimadir **dedi** va u bizga boshqa menyu olib keldi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **told** her parents about the new job before anyone else.
sentences.translation: Nilufar yangi ish haqida hammadan oldin ota-onasi**ga aytdi**.

sentences.text: I've already **explained to** the bank why the payment was late.
sentences.translation: To'lov nega kechikkanini bank**ka** allaqachon **tushuntirdim**.

sentences.text: What did the doctor **say to** you about the test results?
sentences.translation: Shifokor tahlil natijalari haqida siz**ga** nima **dedi**?

sentences.text: Please **tell** me honestly what you think of my plan.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, rejam haqida nima o'ylayotganingizni men**ga** ochig'ini **ayting**.

sentences.text: Nobody **explained to** the new students where the library was.
sentences.translation: Hech kim yangi talabalar**ga** kutubxona qayerdaligini **tushuntirmadi**.

sentences.text: Did Aziz **tell** you why he resigned, or did he just **say** goodbye **to** everyone?
sentences.translation: Aziz siz**ga** nega ishdan ketganini **aytdimi** yoki hamma **bilan** shunchaki **xayrlashdimi**?

sentences.text: It took me an hour to **explain to** my grandmother how video calls work.
sentences.translation: Buvim**ga** video qo'ng'iroqlar qanday ishlashini **tushuntirish** uchun bir soat vaqtim ketdi.

examples.title: No preposition: **phone**, **answer** — but **reply to**
examples.description: O'zbekchada `-ga` bor, inglizchada predlog yo'q: phone / call / text, answer, ask, thank somebody. Lekin reply **to** — predlog bilan.

sentences.text: I'll **phone** you as soon as the plane lands in London.
sentences.translation: Samolyot Londonga qo'nishi bilan siz**ga qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: Why didn't you **answer** my message yesterday?
sentences.translation: Kecha nega xabarim**ga javob bermadingiz**?

sentences.text: We **thanked** the nurses for everything they had done for Dad.
sentences.translation: Dadam uchun qilgan barcha ishlari uchun hamshiralar**ga rahmat aytdik**.

sentences.text: If you get lost, just **ask** a police officer for directions.
sentences.translation: Adashib qolsangiz, shunchaki politsiyachi**dan** yo'lni **so'rang**.

sentences.text: Kate **texted** me at midnight to say she'd arrived safely.
sentences.translation: Keyt yarim tunda eson-omon yetib kelganini aytib, men**ga xabar yozdi**.

sentences.text: Have you **replied to** the invitation from the embassy yet?
sentences.translation: Elchixonadan kelgan taklifnoma**ga** hali **javob berdingizmi**?

sentences.text: The minister refused to **answer** the journalists' questions.
sentences.translation: Vazir jurnalistlarning savollari**ga javob berishdan** bosh tortdi.

sentences.text: Don't forget to **call** your grandmother — it's her birthday today.
sentences.translation: Buving**ga qo'ng'iroq qilishni** unutma — bugun uning tug'ilgan kuni.

sentences.text: Jasur still hasn't **replied to** any of the emails I sent last week.
sentences.translation: Jasur o'tgan hafta yuborgan xatlarimning birortasi**ga** hali ham **javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: Instead of **thanking** the driver, the passenger complained about the music.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchi haydovchi**ga rahmat aytish** o'rniga musiqadan shikoyat qildi.

examples.title: Eyes: **look**, **stare**, **glance**, **smile at**
examples.description: Nigoh yoki yuz ifodasi biror kishi yoki narsaga qaratiladi — **at**: look / stare / glance / smile at.

sentences.text: Everyone turned to **look at** the woman in the red dress.
sentences.translation: Hamma qizil ko'ylakli ayol**ga qarash** uchun o'girildi.

sentences.text: It's rude to **stare at** people on the metro.
sentences.translation: Metroda odamlar**ga tikilib qarash** odobsizlik.

sentences.text: Sarah **glanced at** her watch and realised she was late.
sentences.translation: Sara soati**ga ko'z tashladi** va kechikayotganini angladi.

sentences.text: The baby **smiled at** me as soon as I picked her up.
sentences.translation: Qo'limga olishim bilan chaqaloq men**ga jilmaydi**.

sentences.text: What are you **looking at**? Is there something on my shirt?
sentences.translation: Nima**ga qarayapsan**? Ko'ylagimda biror narsa bormi?

sentences.text: Tom kept **glancing at** his phone during dinner, which annoyed his wife.
sentences.translation: Tom kechki ovqat paytida telefoni**ga** tez-tez **ko'z tashlab turdi**, bu xotinining jahlini chiqardi.

sentences.text: For a few seconds the two strangers just **stared at** each other in silence.
sentences.translation: Bir necha soniya ikki notanish odam jimgina bir-biri**ga tikilib turishdi**.

sentences.text: Don't **look at** the answers until you've finished the test.
sentences.translation: Testni tugatmaguningizcha javoblar**ga qaramang**.

sentences.text: Nobody **smiled at** the new boy on his first day, so he felt lonely.
sentences.translation: Birinchi kuni yangi bola**ga** hech kim **jilmaymadi**, shuning uchun u o'zini yolg'iz his qildi.

sentences.text: When Madina **looked** carefully **at** the contract, she noticed a serious mistake.
sentences.translation: Madina shartnoma**ga** diqqat bilan **qaraganda**, jiddiy xatoni payqadi.

examples.title: **laugh at**, **point at**, **aim at**, **shoot at**
examples.description: Kulgi, imo va zarba nishonga qaratiladi — **at**: laugh at, point at, aim at, shoot / fire at. Qiyoslang: laugh **at** (ustidan) va laugh **with** (birga).

sentences.text: The audience **laughed at** every joke the comedian told.
sentences.translation: Tomoshabinlar komikning har bir hazili**ga kulishdi**.

sentences.text: Please don't **laugh at** my pronunciation — I'm doing my best.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, talaffuzim **ustidan kulmang** — qo'limdan kelganicha harakat qilyapman.

sentences.text: **Pointing at** the cake in the shop window, the little boy started to cry.
sentences.translation: Do'kon vitrinasidagi tort**ga barmog'ini nuqib**, kichkina bola yig'lay boshladi.

sentences.text: In this game you **aim at** the centre of the board to get the most points.
sentences.translation: Bu o'yinda eng ko'p ochko olish uchun taxtaning markazi**ni nishonga olasiz**.

sentences.text: Police **fired at** the tyres of the stolen car to stop it.
sentences.translation: Politsiya o'g'irlangan mashinani to'xtatish uchun uning g'ildiraklari**ga o'q uzdi**.

sentences.text: Were they **laughing at** you, or **with** you? — With me, I hope!
sentences.translation: Ular sizning **ustingizdan kulishdimi** yoki siz **bilan birga**? — Umid qilamanki, birga!

sentences.text: To scare the wolves away from his sheep, the farmer **shot at** them.
sentences.translation: Bo'rilarni qo'ylaridan haydash uchun fermer ular**ga qarata o'q uzdi**.

sentences.text: Don't **point** that camera **at** me — I look terrible today!
sentences.translation: Bu kamerani men**ga qaratmang** — bugun juda yomon ko'rinyapman!

sentences.text: The new advertising campaign **is aimed at** teenagers.
sentences.translation: Yangi reklama kampaniyasi o'smirlar**ga mo'ljallangan**.

sentences.text: The teacher **pointed at** the map and asked Aziz to find Khiva.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi xarita**ga ishora qildi** va Azizdan Xivani topishni so'radi.

examples.title: **shout at** or **shout to**? **throw at** or **throw to**?
examples.description: **at** — jahl yoki nishon: shout at (jahl bilan baqirmoq), throw at (tegsin deb otmoq). **to** — yetkazish: shout to (chaqirmoq), throw to (ilib olsin deb otmoq).

sentences.text: Please stop **shouting at** the children — they didn't mean to break it.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, bolalar**ga baqirishni** bas qiling — ular buni atayin sindirishmadi.

sentences.text: The guide **shouted to** the group to stay together in the crowded bazaar.
sentences.translation: Gid gavjum bozorda bir joyda turishlarini aytib, guruh**ga baland ovozda chaqirdi**.

sentences.text: Somebody **threw** an egg **at** the politician during his speech.
sentences.translation: Nutq paytida kimdir siyosatchi**ga** tuxum **otdi**.

sentences.text: From the balcony, Nilufar **threw** the house keys **to** her brother, who caught them easily.
sentences.translation: Nilufar balkondan uy kalitlarini ukasi**ga otib berdi**, u ularni osongina ilib oldi.

sentences.text: My boss never **shouts at** anyone, even when things go wrong.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im, hatto ishlar yomon ketsa ham, hech kim**ga baqirmaydi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **shouted to** me from across the street, but I couldn't hear him because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Oliver ko'chaning narigi tomonidan meni **baqirib chaqirdi**, lekin mashinalar shovqini tufayli uni eshitmadim.

sentences.text: Angry fans **threw** bottles **at** the referee after the match.
sentences.translation: G'azablangan muxlislar o'yindan keyin hakam**ga** shishalar **otishdi**.

sentences.text: In basketball you have to **throw** the ball **to** a teammate quickly.
sentences.translation: Basketbolda to'pni jamoadoshing**ga** tezda **uzatishing** kerak.

sentences.text: Why did you **shout at** the waiter? He was only trying to help.
sentences.translation: Nega ofitsiant**ga baqirdingiz**? U faqat yordam bermoqchi edi.

sentences.text: The lifeguard **threw** a rope **to** the swimmer and pulled him out of the river.
sentences.translation: Qutqaruvchi suzuvchi**ga** arqon **tashlab berdi** va uni daryodan tortib oldi.

examples.title: Mixed: at work and at home
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **to**, **at** va predlogsiz fe'llar bir gapda.

sentences.text: Before you **shout at** him, **listen to** his side of the story.
sentences.translation: Unga **baqirishdan** oldin, voqeani uning tilidan ham **eshitib ko'ring**.

sentences.text: Kate **looked at** the screen for a moment and then **explained** the error **to** us.
sentences.translation: Keyt bir lahza ekran**ga qaradi**, keyin xatoni biz**ga tushuntirib berdi**.

sentences.text: When I **phoned** the hotel, the receptionist **apologised to** me for the mistake.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona**ga qo'ng'iroq qilganimda**, qabulxona xodimi xato uchun men**dan uzr so'radi**.

sentences.text: Stop **laughing at** your brother and **talk to** him properly.
sentences.translation: Ukang**ning ustidan kulishni** bas qil va u **bilan** odamdek **gaplash**.

sentences.text: The manager **smiled at** us and **thanked** everyone for staying late.
sentences.translation: Menejer biz**ga jilmaydi** va kech qolib ishlagani uchun hamma**ga rahmat aytdi**.

sentences.text: Has anyone **replied to** the customer who **wrote to** us on Monday?
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni biz**ga yozgan** mijoz**ga** kimdir **javob berdimi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **described** the thief **to** the police and **pointed at** the street where he ran.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza o'g'rini politsiya**ga tasvirlab berdi** va u qochgan ko'cha**ni ko'rsatdi**.

sentences.text: Don't **stare at** your phone while I'm **speaking to** you!
sentences.translation: Men sen **bilan gaplashayotganimda** telefoning**ga tikilib o'tirma**!

sentences.text: Bekzod **threw** the keys **to** his wife and **shouted to** her that he would be late.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kalitlarni xotini**ga otib berdi** va unga kech qolishini **baland ovozda aytdi**.

sentences.text: Could you **ask** the teacher to **explain** the homework **to** you again?
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi**dan** uy vazifasini siz**ga** yana bir bor **tushuntirib berishini so'ray olasizmi**?
